source: library/2003/league/cba_1999_salary_cap_faq_extract.txt (Larry Coon, 1999 Salary Cap FAQ, http://www.cbafaq.com/salarycap99.htm, retrieved 2026-10-02)

cap_holds_percent.source: Q28. Rookie-scale Bird above average is 250% from 2000-01 onward.
cap_holds_percent.cap: Not to exceed the player's maximum salary for his years of service.
cap_holds_percent.last_two_seasons_rule: If the player's salary differed by more than $4 million between the last two seasons of his contract, the percentage applies to the average of those two seasons.

renouncing: Renounced players stop counting; the team loses its Bird, Early Bird and Non-Bird exception for him until the following June 30 and may re-sign him only with cap room or another exception (Q31). A renouncement may be undone only when it made room for a restricted free agent whose team matched (Q32).

restricted_free_agency.rookie_scale: After the fourth year of a first-round rookie-scale contract.
restricted_free_agency.rescind: A rescinded qualifying offer makes the player unrestricted.

early_bird.salary: greater of 175% of previous salary or the average salary

non_bird.salary: greater of 120% of previous salary or 120% of the minimum salary

exceptions.bird_clock: Seasons with the club without being waived or changing teams as a free agent; a trade keeps the clock (Q17, Q23).

rookie_scale.term: three seasons plus a team option for a fourth, exercised by October 31 after the second season
rookie_scale.unsigned_first_round_hold: 100% of scale unless a verbal agreement is higher

unverified: A separate cap-hold rule for players coming off minimum-salary contracts (not found in the FAQ; the standard percentages are applied and flagged).
Any rule tying a cap hold to a pending qualifying offer or offer sheet (not found in the FAQ).
The 2002-03 league average salary is not published in the repository; it is derived from the contract inventory's 2002-03 salaries and used only to decide above or below average.
